create_TokenToKVPoolAllocator: create a TokenToKVPoolAllocator to manage KV cache indices with configurable size, page size, dtype, and device
create_PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator: create a PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator to manage page-aligned KV cache indices with configurable size and page size
alloc_extend_PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator: alloc extend indices for the prefill phase using PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator with prefix and sequence lengths
alloc_decode_PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator: alloc decode indices for the decode phase using PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator with sequence lengths and last location
free_TokenToKVPoolAllocator: free KV cache indices by passing a tensor of slot indices back to the allocator for reuse
